name: CSC Stat Viewer
author: ethan@example.com
description: A React/Vite statistics viewer application with automatic GitHub updates.
startup: npm install && npm run build && npx serve -s build -l ${SERVER_PORT}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server
echo "Current directory: $(pwd)"

if [ ! -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning from ${GIT_REPO}..."
    if [ -d ".git" ]; then
        git pull
    else
        git clone ${GIT_REPO} .
    fi
    
    if [ ! -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        echo "Checking out branch ${GIT_BRANCH}..."
        git checkout ${GIT_BRANCH}
    fi
else
    echo "ERROR: GIT_REPO is not set"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Listing files..."
ls -la

if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    npm install
else
    echo "ERROR: package.json not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installation complete!"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone (e.g., https://github.com/user/repo)

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Git branch to checkout. Leave empty for default branch.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically pull updates from GitHub on server start (true/false)
